prompts.prompt: Create the primary iOS app icon for DONKEY TRUMP, a satirical arcade game, using this character sheet as a STRICT identity and style reference for cartoon Donald Trump. A SINGLE square 1:1 composition, polished modern 3D family-animation visual style exactly matching the reference. A large readable close-up of his expressive grumpy face, distinctive swept golden blond hair, navy suit and bright red tie. Below his face he holds the top edge of one small wooden barrel, with his fingers visible around it; the barrel occupies only the bottom quarter. His face is the clear dominant subject, eyes and mouth readable when reduced to 60 pixels. Comically determined villain expression, closed mouth with a slight frown, not a grimacing scream. Three-quarter slight turn, strong simple silhouette. Smooth rich Arctic-blue background with a subtle cyan glow behind head, warm golden rim light on hair and barrel, attractive high contrast. Compose all essential details within the central 78 percent of the square for Apple's icon corner mask. Full-bleed opaque square image with all four corners filled. Do NOT draw a rounded-square border or mockup, no lettering, no logos, no other characters, no little scenic details. Not a contact sheet. Exact consistent likeness and appealing sculpted 3D quality of reference. High resolution 1024x1024 or larger square.

Edit the supplied Donkey Trump iOS icon into its DARK appearance variant. Preserve EXACT composition, face, character identity, hair, barrel, suit, red tie, proportions and placement. Only change palette and lighting: background becomes very deep midnight navy almost black, with a restrained teal rim glow; soften bright highlights so it suits a dark iPhone Home Screen, retain recognizable golden blond hair, warm face, red tie and rich wood. Keep facial details readable with elegant soft front lighting. Do not add anything. Same square full-bleed image with filled opaque corners. No border, no rounded corners, no text, no extra objects. A coordinated dark version of the same icon, not a new design.

Edit the supplied icon into the monochrome TINTED-APPEARANCE source for an iOS app icon. Preserve exactly the same square composition, cartoon Donald Trump face, hairstyle, hands, barrel, suit and identity. Render entirely in neutral grayscale: absolutely no color, no sepia or blue tint. Smooth near-black background, silver-white hair, medium-light face, strong readable dark eyes and mouth, silver barrel highlights. Optimize the value separation so the silhouette and expression remain readable when the operating system applies a user-selected tint. Preserve beautiful sculptural 3D shading with slightly simplified fine texture. Full-bleed square with fully opaque corners. No text, no border, no rounded mask, no new objects.

Recompose the supplied polished 3D DONKEY TRUMP game artwork into a TALL PORTRAIT mobile promotional poster, aspect ratio approximately 6:13 (1320:2868). This is a NEW portrait composition, not a crop or stretched copy. Preserve exactly the three cartoon characters and the beautiful 3D family-film quality, red girders, turquoise ladders, wooden barrels and Arctic fjord. Keep the title "DONKEY TRUMP" in chunky golden 3D letters with red sides, centered in the upper quarter but leave the top 8 percent quiet sky for phone-safe viewing. Trump in navy suit and RED tie at upper-left BELOW the title, holding a barrel; Vivian in her white outfit with multicolored beaded yoke and boots on a separate upper-right platform, waving; Jumpman Løkke with gray hair, navy suit and BLUE tie prominently centered in the middle-lower area, leaping over a rolling barrel. All three faces recognizable, all key silhouettes comfortably within the portrait frame. Several receding red platforms and teal ladders create a towering vertical ascent toward Vivian. Fjord, snowy mountains, tiny colorful coastal houses and glowing aurora behind them. Warm sunlight, cool blue depth, vivid premium animated game art. Leave the lowest 12 percent as scenic platform/fjord with no faces or important text. No interface, no buttons, no menus, no screenshot claims, no extra words, no badge, no watermark. Title is the only text. Full bleed portrait.

Extract and recreate ONLY the title logo "DONKEY TRUMP" from this reference game artwork as a standalone polished transparent PNG logo. Two stacked lines, DONKEY above TRUMP, exact spelling. Match the existing chunky playful 3D golden-yellow beveled letters, red extruded sides, warm glossy highlights and slightly curved dynamic arrangement. Absolutely no characters, no scenery, no platform, no rectangle, no background glow, no floating particles. TRUE alpha transparency around the entire logo and through all letter holes. Keep the complete logo inside the canvas with a small transparent safety margin on all sides. Wide logo canvas about 2:1, high resolution. The asset will be composited over dark Arctic game artwork. No other text.

Adapt this Donkey Trump 3D game artwork into a WIDER modern iPhone landscape loading background. Target aspect ratio exactly 2868:1320, about 2.173:1, wider than 16:9. Recompose or expand scenery at the sides rather than cropping off important content. Preserve the exact three characters, their faces and costume designs, the central golden red-sided "DONKEY TRUMP" 3D title, and the modern polished family-animation quality. Keep the dynamic scene: heavy cartoon Trump with red tie and raised wooden barrel at upper left, gray-haired Jumpman Løkke with blue tie leaping at center, Vivian with short dark hair and white colorful-beaded Greenlandic outfit waving at upper right. Wooden barrels roll on diagonal red girders connected by cyan ladders over a beautiful Greenland fjord at sunset under the aurora. FULL bodies and Trump's overhead barrel must fit comfortably inside the image: allow at least 7 percent safe space at every edge for iPhone rounded corners and sensor areas. Title and faces stay within central 80 percent width and central 84 percent height. Edge space should be only sky, water, distant scenery or expendable steelwork. Vivid premium cinematic 3D depth and lighting. ONLY title text, absolutely no buttons, UI, controls, menus, captions, branding badges or watermarks. Full bleed ultrawide 2.173:1 landscape.
